source_traces.normal: tracking.merge_request_snapshot obtains target policy and source-bound check generations through fixed gh/glab argument vectors. review_health._route_actionable_review_health fingerprints original review, heads and actionable evidence, then calls request_feature_review_repair through the existing parent authority and Feature admission boundary. source_traces.failure_resume: Unknown policy, missing/pending/stale results, approval waits and snapshot outages retain typed waits without provider admission. Identical material evidence rejoins a persisted repair identity. Task retry compares persisted observation and evaluated generation before claiming another attempt; changed evidence permits ordinary gated reevaluation. A matching independent repair receipt releases the fence, while unrelated merge failures keep their ordinary classification. A saved verified phase alone no longer authorizes Boss completion: the postcheck refreshes forge evidence and rechecks current action/registry digest and local target under the lifecycle lock. Same-Feature selection is explicit in the Task design; no cross-Feature dependency coverage is inferred.
source_traces.verification_limit: The integrated downstream scripted-transport test uses production tracking normalization but substitutes repair admission/action enumeration. It is useful boundary evidence, not the complete real-Git, guarded admission-to-retirement journey. Feature 4's existing acceptance remains responsible for that journey and the integration-required dependency consumers. The current queued-action observation selector covers Tasks owned by the observed Feature; cross-Feature dependency behavior must be demonstrated by final integration evidence rather than inferred from these tests.
